messages:
Alex P: quick sync — weekly GPU capacity forecast. noticed two things: SYD netlink errors spiking 0300-0400 UTC and eu-west cluster-b headroom dropping to ~6% during peak. can we triage and decide rebalancing before monday?
Marta L: saw the same. SYD p95 egress latency jumped ~180ms last night, ASG logs show transient route-flaps. attaching quick snapshot: `s3://infra-metrics/week-12/syd-netlink-03.jsonl`
Ryan S: numbers from forecasting job (short):
`- next 7d GPU hours demand: apac 42k, eu-west 58k, us-central 75k`
`- current reserved capacity hours: apac 50k, eu-west 60k, us-central 80k`
`- projected headroom (peak day): apac +5k (12%), eu-west +2k (3%), us-central +5k (6%)`
Ryan S: eu-west cluster-b is the tight one, 3% headroom is risky if a node goes OOS.
Nishant K: for SYD netlink, ops-run shows repeated BGP withdraws from peer-2 around 03:15 UTC. not sure if it's transit provider or our peering. filing ticket with vendor now.
SRE Bot: incident created: #INC-2026-3317 (SYD netlink BGP flaps). assignee: network-oncall.
Marta L: proposal: hold eu-west canaries tonight and shift 15% of planned burst jobs to apac/US for 24h window. that will free ~9k GPU hours in eu-west for the peak. downside = slightly higher latency for some jobs and +$1.2k/day cost delta.
Alex P: sounds reasonable. need approval from finance for extra spend? Finance previously ok on up to $3k/day in emergency.
Ryan S: quick tradeoff calc: moving 15% burst => eu-west headroom goes from 3% -> ~18%; apac headroom becomes ~0% (we'd consume reserved buffer). us-central remains >3%. we can instead split 10% apac + 5% us-central to avoid apac hitting 0.
Marta L: agree split. also recommend updating routing policy for burst to prefer dedicated eu-other clusters if possible: `rgp migrate-burst --from eu-west-b --to eu-west-a,eu-north-1 --ratio 0.6,0.4`
Nishant K: onboard vendor reply: they see flaps traced to internal eBGP session reset at our edge (likely config mismatch after midnight change). investigating. if it's on our side we can patch quickly and avoid longer shift.
Alex P: timeline decision: if vendor confirms external within 30m, we do partial shift (10% apac, 5% us). if internal, hold off and patch. can Ops Rotation take the change if needed? @Ops Rotation
Ops Rotation: available. I can run the `rgp migrate-burst` and roll back if errors. I'll coordinate with Marta for the exact job IDs.
Ryan S: operational checklist for shift:
- block new canaries in eu-west for 2h
- run `rgp migrate-burst ...`
- monitor 95/99 latency and queue length, alert if tail latency > 250ms or queue backlog > 2k
- cost monitor alert if day spend > $4k
Marta L: I'll prepare the job list. dropping canaries now.
Alex P: thanks. keep thread updated. if vendor says internal, Nishant, escalate to infra-net and schedule midnight patch. otherwise proceed with split migration. :thumbsup: 
SRE Bot: deploy-check passed for migration playbook v2.1.
Nishant K: vendor says likely internal, but needs 15m to confirm root cause. will update.
Alex P: ok — hold until final. end of thread for now.
